rows.label: qst610203_msg0002
rows.name: So much food, mo! Time to eat, mo!!

rows.label: qst610203_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm Jizo, mo~! Thanks to you, I'm
saved, mo.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0006
rows.name:
I came to see the Igna, but they
were so scary I froze and couldn't
move, mo...

rows.label: qst610203_msg0007
rows.name:
Afraid they'd eat me if they found me,
I stayed dead still... Dust piled up
till I looked just like a statue...

rows.label: qst610203_msg0008
rows.name:
I got so hungry I couldn't do
anything, mo.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0010
rows.name: Mo-mo! I made Sumisumi worry, mo~.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0012
rows.name:
Anyway, I'll meet up with Sumisumi
right away and return to Avaritia,
mo~.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0014
rows.name:
Oh, right! Jizo is a craftsman who
makes cylinders for Salvaging, mo~.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0015
rows.name:
If you come to Avaritia, please stop
by Jizo's place, mo.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0016
rows.name: I'll make you a special cylinder, mo~.

rows.label: qst610203_msg0017
rows.name:
I'll be waiting in Goldmund
Residential District, mo~.
